Map Understat team names to football-data.co.uk names

Source: R/data_understat.R
understat_team_mapping.Rd

Returns a named vector mapping Understat names to FD names. This is necessary because team names differ between sources.

Usage

understat_team_mapping(league)

Arguments

league

Character. League code ("E0", "E1", "D1", etc.).

Value

Named character vector (Understat name -> FD name).

See also

Other data: add_understat_xg(), fetch_understat_xg(), join_understat_xg()
